doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Willie Smith, Jimmy Crawford and Dan Grissom
summary: Young praises straw boss Willie Smith and recalls Crawford and singer Dan Grissom.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Was he what they called the straw boss?
So Willie Smith was the straw boss for the Jimmie Lunceford band?

Yeah, he was the straw boss and he was…Willie Smith, he was a nice cat, Willie and I was really good friends. Willie, I loved Willie, he loved me too. When I went in that band he used to call me a kid when I went in. I was a kid, under them, you know what I mean. Willie Smith…you about ready?
That‘s ok, go ahead, finish your thought on Willie, go ahead because…
Willie Smith was, well he was the straw boss of the band…
And so Willie Smith and Jimmy Crawford, Dan Grissom. Dan was a good singer you know, Dan sang.
―It‘s the way THAT you do it!‖ [laughs] No, we‘re going to go ahead and stop now, we‘re going to come back. ―It ain‘t what you‘re doing, it‘s the way THAT you do it.‖ [sings]
Oh, that was a great band, man.
